# Lantern care

The lantern glazing collects a salt haze on every onshore wind, and the haze
is cut with fresh water before it is polished, never after — a dry cloth on
salt grinds the glass.

Two cloths, always: one for the brass, one for the glass. The brass cloth
carries polish, and polish on the glazing is a night's worth of scatter.

The light is lit before dusk, every day. On 1974-03-11 the keeper wrote that
down in the log rather than in a note, and the note is where it belongs.
